findings.title: order() mixin emits wrong value for legacy box-ordinal-group
findings.body: `-webkit-box-ordinal-group`/`-moz-box-ordinal-group` are 1-based (first item = 1), while the modern `order` property is 0-based (default 0). Passing the same `$val` to both means items using `@include order(2)`/`order(3)` (topic.scss `.extra-info-wrapper`, header.scss `.panel`) are ordered differently in old WebKit/Gecko box-model browsers than in modern flexbox, and elements with implicit order 0 cannot be expressed at all. Compute the legacy value as `$val + 1`.

findings.title: align-items() passes modern keywords to -webkit-box-align/-ms-flex-align
findings.body: The legacy properties accept only `start|center|end|baseline|stretch`, not the modern `flex-start|flex-end`. Any future call such as `@include align-items(flex-start)` will emit invalid declarations for `-webkit-box-align`, `-ms-flex-align`, silently producing no legacy fallback. Map the values (or drop the legacy properties).

findings.title: .small-action now a flex container, but children still rely on float/clear
findings.body: `.small-action` gained `@include flexbox()`, which makes `float: left` on `.topic-avatar`/`.avatar` and `float: right` on `button` no-ops (floats do not apply to flex items), and the trailing `clear: both` on the flex container itself is also meaningless here. The button will no longer be pushed to the right edge; use `margin-left: auto` instead, and remove the dead float/clear rules.

findings.title: Floats inside the new flex .contents are ignored
findings.body: `.d-header .contents` is now a flex container, so `float: left` on `.icons`, `.login-button`, `button.sign-up-button` (direct/indirect children that became flex items) no longer has any effect. The removed `.title { float: left; }` was replaced by flex ordering, but these remaining float rules are dead and the resulting spacing/alignment of the icon row and login buttons may differ from before; they should be converted to flex properties.
